svg.text: • All RabbitMQ queues are durable and use persistent messages — survive RabbitMQ restarts.
• Idempotency keys prevent duplicate booking/payment — cached 24hr in Redis. Failed payments can be retried with same key.
• SELECT FOR UPDATE row lock on flight_classes prevents double-booking the same seat class concurrently.
• Notifications Service has no HTTP server — stays alive purely as a RabbitMQ consumer process.
• Flight search cache uses stable sorted JSON key so query param order doesn't affect cache hits (4hr TTL).
